title: Otori Emu — Let's Think Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow☆ All that house's windows are circles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, look over there! Some little birdies made a nest! That's so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And check out that house! Its walls and roof are all red! And it's so big!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, slow down! Don't run off like that! We're not here to explore the city right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
We need to find that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... Let's ask around and do our best so that we can go back to Rui and the others with some good news.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Let's ask lots and lots of people!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Mr. Hippo!
We're looking for a phoenix. Did you happen to see one flying by?

rows.Speaker: Hippo Plushie
rows.Line:
A phoenix...?
Hmm... No, I've never seen one before...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Hippo Plushie
rows.Line:
Sorry I can't be of much help.
Anyway, I need to go. I've got an appointment to keep.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, hello! Have you seen a...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've asked a lot of different plushies about that phoenix, but we still don't know where it's gone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we're just spending a lot of time with nothing to show for it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just hope that Rui and the others have learned something...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... That doggie plushie...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Uhh... This is the center of the market, so that means I'm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's been looking around really nervously for some reason...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Do you think something's wrong?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if he's lost?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna go help!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu, wait!
Honestly... Let's go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi there☆
What's wrong? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'm supposed to meet with a friend... But I think I got lost somewhere along the way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You got lost...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm not sure we'll be of much help.
We still don't really know a whole lot about this city...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, but... We can't just leave.
I wanna help if I can...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, then...
Let's try figuring out where this meeting location is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We might even learn something about where the phoenix went!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Now then...
Let's find where Mr. Doggie's supposed to go!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Could you tell us a little more about where you're supposed to meet your friend?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Um... I'm supposed to find this big house with a red roof and walls!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A house with a red roof and walls...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, didn't we just...?!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
Wow...! Yes, it's here!
This is the place I've been looking for!

rows.Speaker: Hippo Plushie
rows.Line: Ah, there you are! I was wondering where you've been... Wait, you're...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Mr. Hippo, hi again!
So you're the friend Mr. Doggie's here to meet☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't believe the house you saw just earlier turned out to be where they agreed to meet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm glad everything worked out in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! I'm really glad we could help♪

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
Again, thank you very much.
I couldn't have made it here without you!

rows.Speaker: Hippo Plushie
rows.Line: Also, did you find someone who can tell you more about that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, not yet...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: A phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We're looking for this phoenix, but no one else seems to have seen it...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, you might want to head over to the inn.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The inn?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Yes, the one right near the harbor. I'm actually staying there.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: You get to hear lots of rumors because plushies from different islands like to gather there.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: So, you might be able to learn more about this phoenix you're looking for there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, the inn...
Thank you for the tip.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: No, I'm just glad I could also be of help!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
So, good luck finding that phoenix.
I'll be rooting for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad we got him to smile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that we've acquired a nice piece of information, let's go report back to Nene and the others!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna find that phoenix no matter what!
